description: Source code for an HTTP client sample using Zephyr RTOS, implementing IPv4/IPv6 socket connections with optional TLS, performing GET, POST, and chunked POST requests, with callback handling and socket setup.

methods.name: setup_socket
methods.description: Initializes and creates a socket with optional TLS configuration based on family and server parameters.

methods.name: payload_cb
methods.description: Callback to generate and send chunked payload data over the socket.

methods.name: response_cb
methods.description: Handles HTTP response, logging partial or complete data reception.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to the server.

methods.name: run_queries
methods.description: Performs multiple HTTP GET, POST, and chunked POST requests over IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing the sample HTTP client loop.
